title: Previously deselected technicians stay deselected when the user returns to the report
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Technician Utilization report with several technicians listed.
custom_steps:
1. Deselect two technicians.
2. Leave the report (navigate elsewhere), then return; also try a full page reload.
3. Check the two technicians' selection state and the other technicians'.
custom_expected:
1. The two deselected technicians are STILL deselected on return - the deselected set is what persists (saved in this browser, not on the account).
2. All other technicians - including any who appear for the first time - are selected.
3. The saved date range and location selection are restored alongside (per S1-R8).
